shortDescription: FRISCO, TX / ACCESS Newswire / September 10, 2026 / GameSquare Holdings, Inc. children: , a next-generation media, entertainment, technology and digital native treasury company, today announced that Justin Kenna, Chief Executive Officer, will participate in one-on-one investor meetings at the H.C. Wainwright 28th Annual Global Investment Conference, being held September 14-16, 2026, in New York City.
GameSquare will host investor meetings on September 14 and 15. Registered attendees interested in scheduling a meeting with GameSquare management should contact their H.C. Wainwright representative.
For additional information or to register for the conference, please visit the H.C. Wainwright 28th Annual Global Investment Conference website at https://hcwevents.com/annualconference/?utm.

is a cutting-edge media, entertainment, and technology company transforming how brands and publishers connect with Gen Z, Gen Alpha, and Millennial audiences. With a platform that spans award-winning creative services, advanced analytics, and FaZe Esports, one of the most iconic gaming organizations, we operate one of the largest gaming media networks in North America. As a digital-native business, GameSquare provides brands with unparalleled access to world-class creators and talent, delivering authentic connections across gaming, esports, and youth culture. Complementing our operating strategy, GameSquare has developed an innovative treasury management program designed to generate yield and enhance capital efficiency, reinforcing our commitment to building a dynamic, high-performing media company at the intersection of culture, technology, and next-generation financial innovation.
